== Build notes ==
Transcribed from page 1 of [[:File:2007 Worlds Day 2.pdf]] (handwritten fax). [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 23:32, 20 October 2026 (UTC)
* A tick after a card name is read as the player's (V) mark: Wokling, Civil Disorder, Mon Mothma, Red Squadron 7, Impressive, Most Impressive, Han's Toolkit, Affect Mind, Weapons Display, Chasm.
* Line 8 ''Strike Planning'' also has a tick, but no Strike Planning (V) existed in 2007 (it is Virtual Set 21), so the list links [[Strike Planning]].
* Mon Mothma with a tick links [[Mon Mothma (V) (Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon)|Mon Mothma (V) (Virtual Set 9)]].
* Line 60: ''Imperial Atrocity (V)'' is struck through and ''All Wings Combo'' written after it; linked as [[All Wings Report In & •Darklighter Spin]].
* Shield 1 is read as ''Ultimatum''.
